title: Dung Sonang Rohangku
chord: B · G · Am · F · C · G · F · B
lyrics:
Tuhan Debata Sai ramoti ma
Daging dohot tondinami
I do pangidoannami
Sai pahipas be Hami on sude
Jesus Ho tutu Raja na burju
Sai palua tondinami

Sian pardosaonnami
Pasupasu be Hami on sude
Sai parbadiai Sai tongtong rajai
Ale Tondi Parbadia
Rohanami asa ria
Mangoloi hataM Hombar tu rohaM
